bridge.where: The earth, and the closed horizon
text: This is the last chapter of the chronicle. The Hour is not shown, because what each person carried is known only to God; so the Quran's pictures are given instead — the earth levelled, the mountains like wool, the people like moths, and the scales weighed.
It ends where the Quran ends its own surah: on that Day, no one can help anyone else, and the command is entirely with God.
